items.hed: Astros season ended in a Wild Card sweep at home
items.insight: MLB.com reported that Chicago beat Houston 7-3 on Sept. 30 and swept the American League Wild Card Series at Daikin Park. Houston had won the West on the last day of the regular season, then became the first team out. The club finished 81-81. It was the ninth straight home postseason loss, and the second Wild Card sweep in three years.
